**Suite is green.** 625 of 625 pass.

Only 3 cases failed. All were in `orderTotal`. It taxed the full price. The spec taxes the discounted price. Fixed at [src/pricing.js:40](src/pricing.js:40):

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

The other 622 cases hid the bug. They had zero discount or zero tax.

Next: nothing. No other code changed.
